$comment: Roles and permissions shared by the API (app/core/permissions.py) and the app (src/domain/permissions.ts). Code checks permissions, never role names. ADR 0005.

roles.system_admin: Approves new owners; manages owners, shops, users and devices; reads every audit log. Always online. Does not sell.
roles.owner: Owns one or more shops: catalogue, stock, sales, reports, cashiers and devices.
roles.cashier: Sells in one shop. Extra permissions are granted per cashier by the owner.

shop_permissions.members:manage: Create cashiers, set their PINs and permissions, remove them
shop_permissions.devices:manage: Register and revoke the shop's phones
shop_permissions.catalogue:write: Create and edit items and categories
shop_permissions.stock:write: Record restocks, damage, losses and stock counts
shop_permissions.costs:read: See cost prices, profit and margins
shop_permissions.sales:read: View every sale in the shop, not only your own
